methodologyNotes: 13 notable fitness trackers and smart rings compared by buyers in 2026. Seeds per brief: Fitbit Charge 6 / Inspire 3 / Sense 2, Oura Ring 4, WHOOP 4.0 / WHOOP 5.0, Garmin Vivosmart 5 / Venu Sq 2, Samsung Galaxy Ring, Amazfit Band 7, Ultrahuman Ring AIR. Specs sourced from manufacturer pages (Garmin owner manuals, Amazfit US store, Oura support, Samsung, WHOOP membership pages), official announcements (Garmin newsroom, Amazfit PR Newswire), and authoritative reviews (Android Central, Android Authority, DCRainmaker, TechRadar). US MSRP / launch price used throughout. WHOOP price represents the required One-tier annual membership divided by 12 for comparability (hardware bundled free). Fitbit Premium is optional — noted but not factored into priceUsd. ECG = true only for a built-in ECG app, not passive rhythm notifications. GPS = true only for standalone on-device GPS, not connected (phone) GPS. Water resistance is expressed in metres (static depth). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Oct 12 2023 ($159.95 official Google Store price). Fitbit Premium is optional ($9.99/month or $79.99/year); 6 months included free with purchase.
products.provenance: Price $159.95 (official Google Store launch price; Android Authority quotes $159) and release date Oct 12 2023. Display 1.04" AMOLED, built-in GPS (GPS+GLONASS), SpO2, ECG (EDA & ECG sensors) confirmed via Android Authority. Battery up to 7 days (manufacturer claim, ~3 days with always-on display). Water resistance 50m confirmed via Wikipedia and Android Authority. Fitbit Premium optional at $9.99/month. Corrected priceUsd from 159.99 to 159.95 during verification.

products.name: Fitbit Inspire 3
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Sep 29 2022. Fitbit Premium optional ($9.99/month); 6 months included free.
products.provenance: Price $99.95 and launch date Sep 2022 from Notebookcheck news article. Display 0.76" AMOLED confirmed via TechAdvisor and Wikipedia Fitbit article. Battery 10 days (no AOD), 3+ days with AOD from TechAdvisor. No built-in GPS (connected GPS only) confirmed by multiple reviews. SpO2 yes, ECG no — confirmed via Fitbit community and search results. Water resistance 50m confirmed via Google Store spec page and community posts.

products.name: Fitbit Sense 2
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Sep 2022. Fitbit Premium optional ($9.99/month); 3 months included free.
products.provenance: Price $299.95 confirmed by SlickDeals listing and multiple retailer pages. Display 1.58" AMOLED (336x336px) from Tom's Guide review. Battery 6+ days, built-in GPS, SpO2, ECG app confirmed via Amazon listing description and Wikipedia Fitbit article. Water resistance 5 ATM (50m) confirmed via multiple reviews. ECG confirmed in device name and Amazon description.

products.name: Oura Ring 4
products.priceNote: US starting price for titanium finish. Ceramic models are higher. Plus mandatory Oura Membership at $5.99/month ($69.99/year) after first free month.
products.provenance: Battery 5-8 days ("typically 5-8 days") from Oura support page; 8 days is manufacturer max claim used. SpO2 confirmed (red and infrared LEDs, sleep-only). ECG not available confirmed by Oura support page. Water resistance 100m confirmed both by Oura support article and ouraring.com product page. Price $349 from ouraring.com store and Tom's Guide. Membership $5.99/month confirmed from ouraring.com product page. Release Oct 2024 from Tom's Guide and Wikipedia Oura Ring article. No built-in GPS — ring form factor, no GPS chip.

products.name: WHOOP 4.0
products.priceNote: No up-front hardware cost. Requires active WHOOP membership: previously $30/month (monthly) or ~$199/year (One tier annual). WHOOP 4.0 hardware bundled with membership; exact current MSRP not applicable as device is sold only with subscription. priceUsd set null — subscription-only model.
products.provenance: Battery 5 days confirmed via search results (WHOOP 4.0 vs 5.0 comparison). No display (screenless band). SpO2 yes, ECG no (ECG is WHOOP MG/Life-tier only per Wikipedia and WHOOP site). Water resistance IP68 / 10m confirmed via search results (thewearify.com, techloved.com). Subscription required — device non-functional without membership. Release Oct 2021 from DC Rainmaker review URL and Wikipedia. No GPS confirmed; no built-in GPS chip.

products.name: WHOOP 5.0
products.priceNote: No up-front hardware cost. Requires membership: WHOOP One tier $199/year ($16.58/month equiv.), WHOOP Peak $264/year, WHOOP Life $399/year. Hardware bundled. priceUsd set null — subscription-only model.
products.provenance: Battery 14+ days confirmed via WHOOP membership page ("14+ day battery life"). No display (screenless). SpO2 yes (continuous monitoring confirmed). ECG no — ECG is WHOOP MG (Life tier) only, not included in standard 5.0. Water resistance IP68/10m confirmed via search results (versus.com WHOOP 5.0, AliExpress wiki article). Subscription required with One/Peak/Life tiers; pricing from WHOOP EU membership page (EUR amounts noted; USD $199/yr One tier from search results). Release May 2025 from Wikipedia. No GPS.

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.provenance: Price $149.99 confirmed via Notebookcheck launch article and search results. Release Apr 20 2022 from Garmin newsroom and TechRadar review. Display 0.84" monochrome OLED (154x88px) from GSMArena news and Android Central review. Battery 7 days from Garmin official announcement; ~4 days with 24/7 SpO2. No built-in GPS (connected/phone GPS only) confirmed by TechRadar and Android Central reviews. SpO2 yes, ECG no. Water resistance 5 ATM (50m) confirmed by Garmin owner manual and TechRadar. No subscription required.

products.name: Garmin Venu Sq 2
products.priceNote: US MSRP for base model. Music Edition is $299.99.
products.provenance: Price $249 base confirmed via DCRainmaker review and Android Authority. Display 1.41" AMOLED (360x320px) from DCRainmaker. Battery 11 days smartwatch mode from Garmin owner manual and search results. Built-in GPS confirmed (Airoha chipset, GPS-only or All-Systems modes) via DCRainmaker. SpO2 yes, ECG no (Garmin ECG was Venu 2 Plus only per search results). Water resistance 5 ATM (50m) from Garmin owner manual ("Swim, 5 ATM"). Release announced at IFA 2022, Sep 2022 from Android Authority.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Ring
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Jul 24 2024. One price for all sizes 5–13. No mandatory subscription for health features.
products.provenance: Price $399.99 confirmed via Wikipedia and Android Central. Release Jul 24 2024 ship date from Android Central. Battery up to 7 days (size-dependent; 5 days for smallest, 7 days for size 12-13) from Android Central and search results. SpO2 yes (optical heart rate sensor + blood oxygen) confirmed via Beebom FAQ and SlashGear features article. ECG no — explicitly stated "cannot measure ECG" per Beebom FAQ. Water resistance 10 ATM / IP68 (100m) from Wikipedia, Android Central, and Beebom. No subscription required — Samsung stated no monthly fee for health features. No GPS (ring form factor).

products.name: Amazfit Band 7
products.provenance: Price $49.99 confirmed via Amazfit US store page and Android Central review. Display 1.47" AMOLED (198x368, 282 ppi) confirmed by Android Central review and Amazfit store. Battery 18 days (typical use) confirmed by Amazon listing, Android Central, and PR Newswire announcement; 28 days in battery saver mode. No built-in GPS (connected smartphone GPS only) confirmed by Android Central and Amazfit store. SpO2 yes (BioTracker 3.0 PPG, 24-hour monitoring). ECG no — not mentioned in any review or spec page. Water resistance 5 ATM (50m) confirmed by Amazon listing and Android Central. Release Jul 20 2022 from PR Newswire announcement. No subscription required.

products.name: Ultrahuman Ring AIR
products.priceNote: US price for all sizes and finishes (Aster Black, Matte Grey, Bionic Gold, Space Silver). No mandatory subscription; optional PowerPlugs add-ons (e.g. AFib detection) cost extra.
products.provenance: Price $349 (all sizes) confirmed via Android Central review and search results (comparesmartrings.com). Battery 4-6 days from Android Central; 6 days used as manufacturer upper estimate. SpO2 yes (overnight blood oxygen monitoring) confirmed by Android Central. ECG no — not available per Android Central review. Water resistance WR100 (100m) confirmed by Android Central. No subscription required for core data; Wikipedia confirms AFib/PowerPlugs are optional paid add-ons. Release Sep 2023 confirmed by multiple sources. No GPS (ring form factor).

products.name: Fitbit Versa 4
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Sep 2022. Fitbit Premium optional ($9.99/month).
products.provenance: Price $229.95 at US launch Sep 2022. Display 1.58" AMOLED (same panel as Sense 2). Battery 6+ days. Built-in GPS. SpO2 yes. ECG no — Versa 4 omitted the ECG sensor present in Sense 2 (a noted controversy at launch). Water resistance 50m / 5 ATM. No mandatory subscription. Specs confirmed via Wikipedia Fitbit article (product comparison table) and Android Authority review.

products.name: Garmin Lily 2
products.priceNote: US MSRP for Lily 2 (standard). Lily 2 Active (with GPS) is $249.99.
products.provenance: Price $199.99 US launch Jan 2023. Display 0.84" color MIP with decorative lens. Battery 5 days (smartwatch mode). No built-in GPS in standard Lily 2 (GPS added in Active variant). SpO2 yes. ECG no. Water resistance 50m / 5 ATM. No subscription required. Specs sourced from Garmin product page and Android Central review. Note: Lily 2 Active at $249.99 adds built-in GPS.
